question: How does Generous Tit for Tat stop endless revenge loops?
answer: Generous Tit for Tat hits back only about 9 times out of 10 after a defection. Skipping about 10% of retaliations breaks the echo of two players punishing each other in turn. It still retaliates often enough that it is not exploited.
move: A little forgiveness stops one mistake from becoming endless revenge.

web.label: Quiz page asking how Generous Tit for Tat breaks an endless revenge loop caused by one misread cooperation. Choices: it hits back about 9 times in 10, it hits back twice as hard, it never hits back, or it forgives about 1 time in 10. The reader picks one and rates their confidence.

source: Veritasium, “Once you understand game theory, you understand the world.” (YouTube, 2023)
